title: Trevor's World Plugin Configuration
description: Configuration schema for Trevor's World test plugin

message_font_size.description: Font size for the message text

show_time.description: Show the current time below the message

time_font_size.description: Font size for the time text

color.description: RGB color for the message text [R, G, B]

time_color.description: RGB color for the time text [R, G, B]

display_duration.description: How long to display in seconds

scroll_enabled.title: Enable Scrolling
scroll_enabled.description: If true, the message will scroll if it is too wide for the display.

scroll_speed.description: Scroll speed in pixels per frame. Higher values = faster scrolling. Typical range: 1-2 pixels/frame for smooth scrolling. Works with scroll_delay to control actual speed.

scroll_delay.description: Delay in seconds per frame. Lower values = higher FPS = smoother scrolling. Default 0.01 = 100 FPS. For 120 FPS use 0.0083, for 240 FPS use 0.0042.

scroll_loop.description: If true, text loops continuously. If false, scrolls once and stops (one-shot mode).

scroll_gap_width.description: Gap width in pixels between scroll loops (space between end and start of text when looping)
